group.title: A split sensor shipment
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Purchase order summary
Order S318: 120 temperature sensors, packed 20 per carton. Deliver to North Plant reception. The laboratory is not an authorized delivery point.

DOCUMENT 2 — Dispatch notice, September 5
We shipped 60 sensors today in three cartons. The remaining 60 will leave our warehouse on September 8. The split shipment does not change your total order price. Tracking for the first shipment shows delivery expected on September 6.

DOCUMENT 3 — Internal message, September 6, 3:10 p.m.
Reception accepted three cartons at 2:20 p.m. We checked the contents: each carton contains twenty sensors, with no visible damage. The laboratory has requested the first forty sensors for tomorrow’s tests. Please keep the remaining sensors from this delivery in the controlled stock area until needed.
— Receiving team
group.passageZh:
文件一——採購單摘要
S318 訂單：一百二十個溫度感測器，每箱二十個。請送至 North Plant 接待處；實驗室不是核准的收貨地點。

文件二——九月五日出貨通知
今天已以三箱寄出六十個感測器。其餘六十個將於九月八日離開倉庫。分批出貨不改變訂單總價。第一批物流追蹤顯示預計九月六日送達。

文件三——九月六日下午三點十分內部訊息
接待處於下午兩點二十分收下三箱。已核對內容，每箱二十個感測器，外觀沒有損傷。實驗室申請先領四十個供明天測試。請將本次到貨剩餘的感測器放在受控庫存區，待需要時再使用。
——收貨團隊
